relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Unpriced clarity may consume human effort, but only the task-level distinction between necessary work and fixable compensation can classify that effort as debt.

relations.title: 01K-A01 — Human Capacity / Human Intelligence Debt Reusable Component Specification
relations.reading: The human cost of clarity includes keeping intervention capacity available, maintaining it and qualifying alternative information routes, not only time spent on a case.
